message:
Review before saving. This is a first compile: there is no previous almanac, so every rule is new. Sources: 4 files, all read completely, none excluded. No recordings.

Rules by topic, with quotations:
1. Guest fee: $15 per guest per visit, effective 2024-04-01 (committee minutes 2024-03-05, carried 3-1). Quote: "the guest fee is raised to $15 per visit, effective April 1, 2024. Motion carried 3-1." Replaced the $10 in the club rules (2022-03-01): "Each guest pays a fee of $10 per visit." The notice of 2024-03-20 said $12 from 2024-04-01. The minutes of 2024-06-11 record that the notice misstated the fee, so the notice is treated as corrected and not adopted: "the notice of March 20, 2024 misstated the guest fee. The adopted guest fee is $15 per visit."
2. Court booking: weekdays no more than two hours per day (club rules, 2022-03-01): "A member may book a court for no more than two hours per day." Saturdays and Sundays no more than 90 minutes per day, effective 2024-04-01 (minutes 2024-03-05, carried 4-0): "on Saturdays and Sundays a member may book a court for no more than 90 minutes per day. Weekday booking is unchanged."
3. Court hours: CONFLICT. Club rules (2022-03-01): "Courts are open from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. every day." Notice (2024-03-20): "Courts are now open from 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m." The minutes of 2024-03-05 record a failed motion to extend to 10:00 p.m. ("Motion failed 2-2."), which does not change a rule. No document resolves the disagreement.
4. Governance and amendments: club rules adopted at the members meeting, 2022-03-01: "Adopted at the members' meeting of March 1, 2022. Effective March 1, 2022." May be amended by majority vote of the committee: "These rules may be amended by a majority vote of the committee."

Changelog (first compile): no previous version to compare; all four topics are new. Open items: none; no action items or due dates appear in the documents. Conflicts: 1 (court hours). Provisional items: none. Exclusions: none.

Proposed file name: almanac-2026-11-22-v1.md, saved in Board Documents/Almanac.

Do you approve saving this almanac? Reply yes to save, or tell me which passage was misread. Saying no stops the compile.
